notes.title: The mini-game "Decopin Power Stadium" has been improved.
notes.content:
-Added processing and display actions when donuts fly too far.
-Displays the launch angle and launch speed of the donuts.
Please update to the latest version.

notes.title: DECOPIN POWER STADIUM is now open
notes.content:
DECOPIN POWER STADIUM is now open.

Your "Decopin Power" will be tested in this stadium.
Please make full use of the unpopular status "Decopin Power".
Use your powerful Decopin Power to fly the donuts faraway!!

*You can try this after clearing normal mode.
*Please update to the latest version of Decopins2.

notes.title: Sacred Sphere has implemented homing missile.
notes.content:
Sacred Sphere has implemented homing missile.
When the level of the sacred sphere exceeds 10, it will start firing homing missiles.
The number of shots will increase to a maximum of 10 depending on the level of the sacred sphere.
Please update to the latest version of Decopins2.

notes.title: Implemented patch Ver.2.4.1.
notes.content:
Implemented patch Ver.2.4.1.

-Possible to [u]cancel the sale of magic gems for 6 seconds[/u] after selling them. After selling, a cancel button will appear under the column.
-The resale value of magic gems has been set to 100%.

Please update to the latest version.

notes.title: Implemented patch (ver 2.4.0)
notes.content:
Implemented patch as followings.

-Fast level up for level 50 and above.
-Implemented generation of more expensive money (Blue diamond) than gold statue. Reduces GPU drawing process when a large amount of money is generated.
 *Also corrected the algorithm for money generation.

Thank you.

notes.title: Implement a Hungry Mode
notes.content:
Added a Hungry Mode - Approximately 10 times amount of the donuts.
- Amount of the donuts is really large, so please consider the performance of your graphic board before trying this mode.
- Only those who have cleared Death Mode have the right to challenge. 
- There are no clear rewards but new achievements.

notes.title: A soundtrack player has been installed
notes.content:
A soundtrack player has been installed in the game.
After clearing normal mode, you can play it from home.
We have chosen all the wonderful musics  that will make the game even more exciting.
The best regards to  everyone who created wonderful musics.

notes.title: Implemented patches for adjustments.
notes.content:
The following items have been adjusted.
-Not to change enemy's HP in the 1 minute challenge in Hell/Death mode.
-The behavior of homing donuts on PCs with fast calculation processing.
-The status of various magic.

notes.content:
